name: Kewal Kiran Clothing Ltd
title: Kewal Kiran Clothing Ltd - 532732 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Analyst / Investor Meet - Outcome

read.thesis: Apparel brand owner with FY26 revenue up 20.9% to INR 1,212 cr and EBITDA margin 19.6%, but growth target lifted to 20% CAGR via acquisitions; no capacity signal, mostly outsourced manufacturing.

triggers.label: Growth target raised to 20% CAGR
triggers.quote: we aim to further accelerate the growth target from 15% CAGR to 20% CAGR in the next three years
triggers.highlight: accelerate the growth target from 15% CAGR to 20% CAGR

triggers.label: No price hike taken yet
triggers.quote: We have not taken any price hike yet. We operate at the same prices.
triggers.highlight: We have not taken any price hike yet

triggers.label: Exports to stay flat or decline
triggers.quote: we think that the exports are going to remain constant or may degrew for the next year
triggers.highlight: exports are going to remain constant or may degrew

guidance.quote: organically, our growth, we still say that it should be around 15%-18%
